subject: Aligning on dedicated capacity sizing slot — Bluetide Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha@bluetide.ai>, Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@bluetide.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning on dedicated capacity sizing slot — Bluetide Analytics

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to learn more about Bluetide's ingestion patterns and the projected ramp. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can scope Dedicated properly: 

- Goal: reserve a Dedicated GPU pool sized to meet peak inference throughput while keeping 99p latency under ~150ms for your interactive tagging UI.
- Key unknowns we need on the sizing call: peak QPS per model, average & max sequence length, KV cache hit assumptions, and acceptable cold-start behavior.
- Constraints you mentioned: EU data residency for a subset of PII workloads, and a hard budget cap for committed spend in Q3.

Can we lock a 60-minute dedicated sizing deep-dive next week? Proposed slots (Pacific times):
- Tue 2027-07-27 09:00–10:00 PT
- Tue 2027-07-27 13:00–14:00 PT
- Wed 2027-07-28 08:00–09:00 PT

I've attached a short sizing template (bluetide-sizing-template.xlsx) with the metrics that help us produce a pre-call estimate — if you can fill the peak QPS and average seq length fields ahead of the call, that will speed things up.

Agenda for the call (60 min):
1) Quick walk of your traffic profile & models (10 min)
2) Throughput/latency targets and SLAs (10 min)
3) Preliminary sizing and trade-offs (30 min)
4) Next steps: committed pool recommendation + timeline (10 min)

CC'ing Priyom (solutions) and Logan (solutions infra) — they'll lead the technical deep-dive.

If those slots don't work, tell me preferred windows and we'll adapt.

Thanks,

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the template. Tue 7/27 generally looks good for us — preference for the 13:00 PT slot. A couple quick clarifications before we lock calendar: 

- Can the call cover 99th percentile latency targets for both our inference path (model scoring) and the streaming tagging UI? We have slightly different SLOs for each.
- For EU residency: we only need persistent storage of raw PII artifacts in the EU — inference can run in a US pool if that's cheaper, but we'd like to understand options.
- We'll try to populate the sizing template today but may only have averaged QPS across models; is that sufficient for a first-pass sizing?

Also attaching a network diagram that shows our on-prem collector and the cloud bridge (bluetide-network-diagram.pdf) — hopeful that helps Priyom and Logan prep.

If 13:00 PT works, we can send a calendar invite and provide dial-in details.

Best,
Samantha Reed
Head of ML Infrastructure, Bluetide Analytics
samantha@bluetide.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Marissa / Logan —

Saw Samantha's note and the network diagram — thanks to the Bluetide team for sending that over. I can take lead on the technical portion for the 7/27 13:00 PT slot. Quick checklist I want pre-filled or available during the call: 

- Per-model peak & average QPS (or aggregate if per-model is not available)
- Example input/output sizes and average token/sequence lengths
- Expected concurrency pattern (bursts vs steady) and any daily/weekly seasonality windows
- Any model quantization constraints or proprietary kernels we need to validate
- Confirmation on which workloads require EU residency for storage vs inference

I've created a short shared doc with a pre-call checklist and a link to our sizing heuristics: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SizingChecklist — please ask Bluetide to paste whatever metrics they have there before the meeting; we'll use it to run an on-the-fly calc and come with a recommended pool size.

Logan — can you review the network diagram offline and flag any expected egress/peering concerns? I'll prepare a minimal set of perf curves (QPS -> GPUs for 99p ranges) to present.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
